worked.problem: A rectangular tile is 90 mm long and 7 cm wide. Find its perimeter in cm and area in cm².
actions: Label the length 90 mm and width 7 cm on the rectangle.
Convert 90 mm ÷ 10 = 9 cm, so the two dimensions now share cm units.
Perimeter = 2(9 + 7) = 32 cm.
Area = 9 × 7 = 63 cm².
Check: opposite sides sum to 32 cm; 9 columns of 7 square centimetres give 63 cm².
worked.check: Check: opposite sides sum to 32 cm; 9 columns of 7 square centimetres give 63 cm².
worked.misconception: Keep the given lengths and units attached to the correct edges; perimeter counts boundary length, area counts square units.
